t: In front of you in Parliament Square is a bronze statue of Edward Smith-Stanley, the 14th Earl of Derby. It's Grade II listed, and was unveiled on 11 July 1874. Derby was a Conservative statesman who served three times as Prime Minister, one of only four to have three or more separate periods in office. He also introduced the state education system in Ireland and reformed Parliament. The sculptor was Matthew Noble, a leading portrait sculptor of the Victorian age, whose monumental figures and busts of royalty and statesmen also stand in Westminster Abbey and St Paul's Cathedral.
